name: casefile
description: Casefile: the case file for every task, shared across sessions, agents and people. Needs a Casefile server you run (one-line Docker install). Claude Code connects through this plugin; the Claude Desktop chat needs the casefile.mcpb extension from the latest release. The skill walks an agent through taking a task, keeping its case, asking the human, handing it off and closing it with verdicts; the MCP connector signs in through OAuth, no token in the plugin.

interface.longDescription: Casefile keeps a case file for every task, shared by every session, agent and person: decisions, attempts, findings, summaries and open questions, so the next one carries on instead of starting over. This plugin carries the Casefile skill and the Casefile MCP connector. The skill teaches an agent to work a task through the Casefile MCP server step by step: enter the task and read its case, record decisions, attempts and summaries as the work goes, ask the human and wait for the answer, hand the task off when the next move is someone else's, split it into children, resolve remarks and close it with a verdict on every check and an honest account of what no check measured. The exact rules come from the Casefile MCP server itself; connecting and signing in are covered by the Casefile guide for agents. The connector points at http://127.0.0.1:8100/mcp, an installation on the same machine; it carries no token and no account, the agent signs in through OAuth. For a server at another address, add it with `codex mcp add casefile --url <address>`.
defaultPrompt: Take the next open task from my Casefile tracker
